description: One repository's Tasks file (<work>/tasks-<slug>.json): agent task-decomposer writes it, the step `task_decomposition.task_grouping_check` (orchestrator/flows/task_decomposition.py) validates it against this file and then checks the grouping (scripts/portfolio/hierarchy.py), and the Task bead writes and the task-dependency-mapper read it. Task keys are local, T1, T2 and so on. acceptanceCriteria and definitionOfDone cite the stable ids of the repository's criteria document (spec-<slug>.criteria.md), never copied requirement prose. requirementIds cite the `items` of the repository context (spec-context.schema.json) and the TRD requirement ids that apply; decisionIds cite arc42 documents and headings the decomposer read; specPaths and specSections cite the spec documents; reuses names retained work of the same Story; blockedByExternal names blockers in other Epics. A Task is a coherent unit of build work: it covers several of the things the Story builds, every thing the Story builds is cited by some Task, and it is never one Task per thing; a Task that cites an event also cites a service or component that publishes it, and no Task covers events alone. surfaces are named from api-contract, event-chain, auth, performance, web-ui, ios, android, cross-platform-mobile, ml and data-pipeline; [] means none and null unknown. testStrategy is the source's pyramid, coverageThreshold, envMatrix and source, or null. edges run from prerequisite to dependent by local key. scores size each Task under the wsjf skill's scale: jobSize lies within the positive range sizeLow..sizeHigh and sizeConfidence is 0..100. Complete means every thing the Story builds is cited, there is at least one Task, and every Task is sized.

type.description: The kind of work; a value of the infrastructure vocabulary (infra-vocabulary.schema.json types) marks an infrastructure Task, whose bead is labelled so its build adds Infra Intent. A Task that builds a piece of infrastructure is labelled whatever its type.
